findings.evidence: Rockwell's FY2025 Form 10-K states sales to its two largest distributors in 2025, 2024 and 2023 were approximately 20% of total sales, attributable to all three segments. This is the current primary-source concentration fact required by the queue blocker.

Current SEC filings materially close the queue gate. Teradyne's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports 156.540 million common shares at March 29, 2026, no outstanding balance under the $750 million senior secured revolver at March 29, covenant compliance, and sufficient cash/securities/revolver capacity for at least twelve months; the June 28 filing again states covenant compliance and reports only 0.2 million shares repurchased for $74.2 million in the first six months. The 2026 proxy confirms 156,559,428 shares outstanding on the record date and current governance/compensation framework. The predecessor convertible notes identified in older filings were due December 15, 2023; no current convertible-note obligation is surfaced in the 2026 quarterly debt discussion. Treat future equity awards as normal dilution monitoring rather than an unresolved current convertible-debt gate.
